copy.headline: GTA 6 Players Are Upset Its New Train Can Actually Be Stopped After Spending 13 Years With the Unstoppable…
copy.caption: GTA 5's unstoppable train has been a meme for a decade, so naturally, players wasted no time trying to stop GTA 6's train – but they were sad to find out that it wasn't all that hard to do.
